# SharpCell

> A free (MIT) Excel formula engine for .NET 8 and later: it reads .xlsx files, recalculates them, saves the results back and evaluates formulas, including dynamic arrays, LET/LAMBDA and tables with structured references. Results are checked against workbooks calculated by Microsoft Excel.

Packages: `SharpCell` (the engine, no dependencies) and `SharpCell.Xlsx` (reads .xlsx and saves values back). Namespaces: `SharpCell`, `SharpCell.Xlsx`. Call `Workbook.Recalculate()` after changing cells; values do not update on assignment. Excel errors are values, not exceptions. A `Workbook` is not thread-safe.

## Docs

- [Overview](https://ifmelate.github.io/SharpCell/index.md): What SharpCell is, its packages and a first example.
- [Getting started](https://ifmelate.github.io/SharpCell/getting-started.md): Install, read an .xlsx file, recalculate, read values; walks through the console sample.
- [Formulas and values](https://ifmelate.github.io/SharpCell/guides/formulas.md): Formula syntax, references, CellValue kinds, dynamic arrays, names and LAMBDA, parse errors.
- [Recalculation](https://ifmelate.github.io/SharpCell/guides/recalculation.md): When values update, volatile functions, cancellation, diagnostics, threads, culture and dates.
- [Reading .xlsx files](https://ifmelate.github.io/SharpCell/guides/xlsx.md): What the reader loads and skips, saved results, streams, unsupported formats.
- [Saving .xlsx files](https://ifmelate.github.io/SharpCell/guides/saving.md): Writing recalculated values back into the file a workbook was read from: what is written, what is refused, KeepUncalculated.
- [Tables and hidden rows](https://ifmelate.github.io/SharpCell/guides/tables.md): Structured references such as Sales[Units], tables from .xlsx files and code, hidden rows and filters in SUBTOTAL and AGGREGATE.
- [Functions](https://ifmelate.github.io/SharpCell/guides/functions.md): Function status, criteria syntax for COUNTIF and friends, dates as numbers, regular expressions.
- [What SharpCell does not do](https://ifmelate.github.io/SharpCell/guides/limits.md): Every known gap in one list.
- [For AI coding agents](https://ifmelate.github.io/SharpCell/agents.md): llms.txt, llms-full.txt and rules to paste into an agent's instructions.

## API reference

- [CalculationDiagnostic](https://ifmelate.github.io/SharpCell/api/SharpCell.CalculationDiagnostic.md): Something calculation noticed that is not visible in cell values alone.
- [Cell](https://ifmelate.github.io/SharpCell/api/SharpCell.Cell.md): A handle to one cell position.
- [CellRange](https://ifmelate.github.io/SharpCell/api/SharpCell.CellRange.md): A rectangle of cells on one sheet, such as `A1:C10`.
- [CellValue](https://ifmelate.github.io/SharpCell/api/SharpCell.CellValue.md): A value produced by a cell or a formula.
- [CellValueKind](https://ifmelate.github.io/SharpCell/api/SharpCell.CellValueKind.md): The kind of value a CellValue holds.
- [DateSystem](https://ifmelate.github.io/SharpCell/api/SharpCell.DateSystem.md): The workbook's date system: which day serial number 0 or 1 stands for.
- [DefinedName](https://ifmelate.github.io/SharpCell/api/SharpCell.DefinedName.md): A defined name as Workbook.DefinedNames lists it.
- [DiagnosticKind](https://ifmelate.github.io/SharpCell/api/SharpCell.DiagnosticKind.md): What a CalculationDiagnostic reports.
- [ErrorKind](https://ifmelate.github.io/SharpCell/api/SharpCell.ErrorKind.md): Excel error values.
- [ErrorKinds](https://ifmelate.github.io/SharpCell/api/SharpCell.ErrorKinds.md): Conversion between ErrorKind and its literal text (`#DIV/0!`).
- [FormulaParseException](https://ifmelate.github.io/SharpCell/api/SharpCell.FormulaParseException.md): Thrown when formula text cannot be parsed.
- [FunctionArguments](https://ifmelate.github.io/SharpCell/api/SharpCell.FunctionArguments.md): The arguments of one call of a function added through Workbook.Functions.
- [FunctionCollection](https://ifmelate.github.io/SharpCell/api/SharpCell.FunctionCollection.md): The functions a workbook's formulas can call besides Excel's: add one with FunctionCollection.Add, and formulas calling it by name (ignoring case) use it from the next calculation on.
- [FunctionOptions](https://ifmelate.github.io/SharpCell/api/SharpCell.FunctionOptions.md): How a function added through Workbook.Functions takes its arguments.
- [LambdaValue](https://ifmelate.github.io/SharpCell/api/SharpCell.LambdaValue.md): A function value produced by `LAMBDA`.
- [Table](https://ifmelate.github.io/SharpCell/api/SharpCell.Table.md): An Excel table: a named range with column names, an optional header row and an optional totals row.
- [Workbook](https://ifmelate.github.io/SharpCell/api/SharpCell.Workbook.md): A workbook: sheets, defined names and calculation settings.
- [Worksheet](https://ifmelate.github.io/SharpCell/api/SharpCell.Worksheet.md): A sheet of a Workbook.
- [XlsxReader](https://ifmelate.github.io/SharpCell/api/SharpCell.Xlsx.XlsxReader.md): Reads .xlsx workbooks: sheets, values, formulas with the results Excel cached, defined names, tables, hidden rows, whether a sheet is filtered, and the date system.
- [XlsxWriteException](https://ifmelate.github.io/SharpCell/api/SharpCell.Xlsx.XlsxWriteException.md): A workbook was not saved because SharpCell could not calculate some of its formulas; see XlsxWriteOptions.KeepUncalculated.
- [XlsxWriteOptions](https://ifmelate.github.io/SharpCell/api/SharpCell.Xlsx.XlsxWriteOptions.md): Options for XlsxWriter.
- [XlsxWriter](https://ifmelate.github.io/SharpCell/api/SharpCell.Xlsx.XlsxWriter.md): Saves a workbook read by XlsxReader back into its file with new values: change input cells, call Workbook.Recalculate, save.
